articles.title: Intensified Russian strikes are tearing Kyiv apart, warns mayor
articles.description: Vitaliy Klitschko says Ukraine's capital is in a "very dramatic situation" as Russia hits critical infrastructure.

articles.title: 'I was not going to let others die' - pilot of Flydubai flight describes cockpit attack by co-pilot
articles.description: Capt Smit Machchhar tells Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi he opened the cockpit door to let others in during the attack.

articles.title: Spanish PM Sánchez loses key housing crisis vote after eviction of woman, 87
articles.description: The defeat raises pressure on Sánchez to call a snap election, after a series of scandals affecting his party and allies.

articles.title: Seoul warns 'further action' if Ukraine does not apologise over prisoner-of-war row
articles.description: President Lee Jae Myung also accused Kyiv of "attempting to provoke a war on the Korean Peninsula".

articles.title: Netanyahu says Flydubai attacker had 'Islamist radical indoctrination'
articles.description: Israel's prime minister says the pilot who tried to take over the Flydubai plane clearly intended to "down the plane".

articles.title: Ethiopia and Eritrea cut diplomatic ties as northern conflict escalates
articles.description: The diplomatic fallout comes as Ethiopian forces battle rebel fighters across its northern region.

articles.title: Putin warns West that Russia is ready to use every weapon to protect Kaliningrad
articles.description: The Russian leader insists Moscow is "not threatening anyone" and is merely responding to statements by Western leaders.

articles.title: Russian dissident Garry Kasparov says US warned him of danger to his life
articles.description: "My family and I will not truly be safe as long as Putin is in power," says the former chess world champion.

articles.title: Hero captain describes fight to open cockpit door while being attacked by co-pilot
articles.description: The Indian pilot stabbed by his colleague mid-air has said he "could not let people die" as he described how he fought to open the cockpit door while still being attacked.
